name: @hrizzup/social
description: The code R5 to R14 share for social's V1 beta (docs/social/build.md): paging cursors, edge tags, invite codes and claim tokens, story briefs, Redis key names and the board's filters. Plain functions, no database and no Redis client; server only (codes and briefs hash with node:crypto), except cursor, tags and lists, which a page may import by their own file (`@hrizzup/social/lists`).
